name: live-reasoning
note: Live suite: a real model, no network targets and no sandbox images needed — tasks are solvable with note and complete_task, so the metrics are about instruction following, schema repair and cost, not about reaching a host. mistral is picked for speed; a thinking model such as qwen3.5 needs timeout_seconds of 300+.

scenarios.title: One task: write a note, then close it

tasks.title: Recon. Use only the note and complete_task commands: note with key 'surface' and a value naming one page worth testing, then complete_task

scenarios.title: Two tasks done in order, each with its own note

tasks.title: Recon. Use only the note and complete_task commands: note with key 'surface' and a value naming one page worth testing, then complete_task
Testing. Use only the note and complete_task commands: note with key 'hypothesis' and a value describing one test, then complete_task

scenarios.title: A request for an unregistered tool, then recovery

tasks.title: Probe. Request the tool 'nmap_scan' once — it is not registered. Do not try other tools afterwards: use note with key 'recovery' and a short value, then complete_task

scenarios.title: Two independent tasks on a two-worker swarm

tasks.title: Recon. Use only the note and complete_task commands: note with key 'surface' and a value naming one page worth testing, then complete_task
Analysis. Use only the note and complete_task commands: note with key 'risk' and a value naming one risk class, then complete_task
